question: Through which yogic channel should the goddess be contemplated as meditation itself?
premises: Meditation is prescribed along the suṣumnā path.
She is characterized as having the form of meditation.
inference: The practitioner should contemplate the goddess, whose form is meditation, along the suṣumnā.
plain_english: O goddess, one should meditate along the path of the suṣumnā on her whose form is meditation.
